title: Launcher run registration POST returns 503 "registration persistence is not yet acknowledged (durability_wait, deadline)"; the run loses native wait and host credit while still running
outcome:
A launcher run's host registration either commits and is acknowledged, or the launcher and its caller get a definite outcome they can act on. An acknowledgement that is slow only because the persistence writer is queued does not leave a running test without native wait or host credit, and does not leave its commit status uncertain.

Observed 2026-11-08 at about 00:46Z on Central by Engram::Merger: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- cargo build --release --bin engram -j 2` in C:\github\Personal\Engram\.worktrees\central-readiness-0c012df9. The launcher printed STARTED (run test-0e7c8f4e-9a6d-477d-9877-fc64eba3dced, pid 118684), then "registration unconfirmed; native-wait unavailable; use --notify; not host check credit". The POST returned HTTP 503: `test run registration persistence is not yet acknowledged; the operation may still commit; retry the unchanged original request; phase=durability_wait; category=deadline; elapsedMs=5226; phaseElapsedMs=5012; stateInnerWaitMs=4; stateInnerHoldMs=196; writerProgress=queued for the writer; fenceError=Deadline; attemptId=277cb6ff-c4fd-4111-a5e4-b5843b6c03fc`. The build kept running. The caller rightly did not retry, because the commit status was uncertain.

Context: Central was under memory pressure from other applications at the time (free virtual memory had dropped to about 8–20 GB). The writer queue wait was about 5 s; the StateInner hold was 196 ms.
acceptance: The cause of the 5 s writer-queue wait is recorded from evidence: what the persistence writer was busy with, and whether the 5 s durability deadline is appropriate for this phase. It names whether this is product behavior (writer starvation or a deadline too tight for one registration) or an environment effect.

The registration outcome becomes definite for the launcher. One option: the launcher itself re-sends the unchanged original request with the same attempt identity, exactly as the 503 instructs, until the outcome is known within a bounded budget, so that a committed registration is recovered and a running test keeps native wait and credit. Another: the host acknowledges a queued registration without a deadline refusal. No duplicate registration, no change to test semantics, and no blind retry of the test itself. Deterministic tests cover a delayed writer acknowledgement that later commits, and one that never commits.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.

completion.summary: Landed bounded same-identity registration recovery in bf7ff309, preserving typed pending on every unconfirmed recovery exit.
